messages:
Maria Lopez: Hey team — planning a 3-week partner onboarding lab for two mid-market customers (NimbleHealth + BrightLine). Need hosts, slide deck finalization, and a simple feedback loop for renewals team.
Sanjay Patel: I can host Tue/Thu mornings next week. What's the expected duration per customer?
Maria Lopez: 60–75 mins each. 30m demo + 30–45m hands-on. Prefer smaller cohorts (6–8 engineers).
Lee Nguyen: I can take NimbleHealth on Thursday 10am PT. Will update the enablement deck.
Kevin O'Connor: I'll help capture feedback and send post-session survey. Can we use the same rubric as Q1?
Maria Lopez: Yes — use the Q1 rubric. Kevin, please add a "renewal risk" flag field.
Enablement Bot: A calendar series was created: Partner Onboarding Lab (NimbleHealth) — Thu 10am PT — 1hr
Sanjay Patel: Quick q — do we want dedicated envs per customer or shared sandbox?
Maria Lopez: Dedicated envs preferred for security + parity. I'll ping infra for 2 sandboxes.
Lee Nguyen: Deck updated: link https://docs.redwood.ai/enablement/nimble-deck-v2 ✅
Kevin O'Connor: Survey draft in Sheet: https://sheets.redwood.ai/partners/onboard-feedback — added 'renewal_risk' col
Sanjay Patel: I'll take BrightLine if someone else can lead the demo portion for NimbleHealth.
Maria Lopez: @Lee can you lead demo for NimbleHealth? @Sanjay will do BrightLine demo.
Lee Nguyen: Yep, demo is on me. I'll prep a short walkthrough script.
Enablement Bot: Reminder: recordings will be auto-saved to enablement-uploads S3 and shared within 24h.
Maria Lopez: Need volunteers to run the hands-on breakout rooms (2 per session). Who's available?
Sanjay Patel: Happy to moderate one breakout.
Kevin O'Connor: I can run one breakout and monitor chat for questions.
Anna Ramos: (joins) I can help with signup tracking — send me the seat list.
Maria Lopez: Thanks — Anna please add a column for 'trial_usage' in the signup sheet.
Sanjay Patel: One more thing — would love a short FAQ doc for common setup issues.
Lee Nguyen: I'll add a troubleshooting page to the repo; snippet:
```
Common fixes:
- GPU quota: request via infra@redwood
- CORS issues: ensure origin whitelisted
```
Maria Lopez: Great. I'll compile agenda and post in #customer-success by EOD tomorrow.
Kevin O'Connor: +1. Also suggest a brief NPS question at the end.
Maria Lopez: Done — agenda posted and calendar invites sent. Thanks all :tada:
